behavior: The executed PowerShell ACL helper must appear in the current frozen implementation inventory and match its SHA256 before any native request.
Missing/changed helper rejects launch admission. Historical plans are preserved byte-for-byte; neither can authorize the changed code.
Failure receipts retain only closed phase/code/ACL-mode values and fixed exception categories; arbitrary message, stderr, class-name and path input remains absent.
First SecureEmpty failure remains before child folders, baseline, image/guard/create/start. Cleanup failure is recorded separately.
limits: ACL semantics were not changed and the actual Windows failure is unconfirmed.
Provider/daemon replies and failures are modeled; no native ACL/Docker calls or retry.
A fresh reviewed manifest and separate exact authorization are required before another native stage.
preparation_failures_retained: Agent reported one test harness initialization TypeError before discovery; corrected native barrier timing before passing checks.
